beats.place_detail: loading boxes into a moving truck outside the old apartment
beats.event: Spent the morning loading boxes into the moving truck with Reza's help
beats.quote: my arms are never forgiving me for this

beats.place_detail: a new apartment building with a broken elevator, four flights of stairs
beats.event: Carried everything up four flights of stairs at the new place because the elevator was broken
beats.quote: so it was all stairs, four flights, over and over

beats.place_detail: a mattress on the floor of an unfurnished new apartment
beats.event: Collapsed onto the mattress on the floor and didn't move for an hour once finished

panels.action: Hauling another box into the truck with Reza.
panels.caption_b: Reza and I load the whole truck.

panels.action: Trudging up flight three with a broken elevator.
panels.caption_a: Four flights, no elevator, over and over.
panels.caption_b: The elevator picked today to break.

panels.action: Face-down on a mattress on the floor.
panels.caption_a: Didn't move for a full hour after.
panels.caption_b: Collapsed the second the truck was empty.

panels.action: Four flights up, again, with no elevator.
panels.caption_a: The stairs won today, not us.
panels.caption_b: So many flights, so many boxes.

panels.action: Sprawled on a bare mattress, completely done.
panels.caption_a: Didn't move for an hour. Earned it.
